basic-attack.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
basic-attack.rationale: Repeatable, free weapon attack: about 14 damage with the reference sword or staff; staff also reaches 3 tiles. This definition is valued equipped, unlike the Library's unarmed 6-damage preview. Unarmed use is substantially weaker.

crushing-blow.rationale: 14 mean melee damage with a 30% one-turn stun chance, free with cooldown 2. Add expected denied actions only for surviving targets; melee access and failed procs constrain control.

stone-bark.rationale: Multiplies existing armor by 1.25 for two target end steps, costing 10 mana with cooldown 3 and a cast action. At 12 armor this adds only 3 armor briefly; at zero armor it adds nothing. Self-cast consumes its first duration tick immediately.

rootgrasp.rationale: 19 mean magical damage in a cross at range 3, with a 40% one-turn stun chance. Damage plus denied actions across about 1.5 useful targets, reduced for 15 mana, cooldown 4 and formation dependence.

stunning-strike.rationale: 23 mean physical melee damage with a 30% one-turn stun chance, free with cooldown 2. Damage and probabilistic action denial together exceed the reference, but require close access and a surviving target.

staggering-jab.rationale: 5 mean melee damage with a 20% one-turn stun chance, free with cooldown 1. Low immediate payoff and unreliable control; the described paralysis is a stun, not a separate additional effect.

battle-roar.rationale: A 60% chance to deny one enemy action at range 2, with no damage. Costs a caster action, 15 mana and cooldown 3. Value denial of a live threatening enemy rather than treating a chance-based stun as guaranteed damage.

rupture.rationale: 10 mean physical melee damage and a 20% chance of two 4-damage bleed ticks, free with cooldown 1. Tick completion depends on survival, so the bleed receives less credit than immediate damage.

volt-lash.rationale: Four global random hits of about 22 damage each, each with a 30% stun chance, for 35 mana and cooldown 4. Large immediate payoff and control; repeated hits encounter defense individually, and repeated stuns/overkill do not count as four distinct denied actions.

final-verdict.rationale: 37 mean melee damage for 10 mana and cooldown 2, with a special strike against targets at or below 10% HP. The finisher still passes through defenses and is capped by remaining useful HP; never value the substituted max-HP coefficient as uncapped damage.

aegis-wall.rationale: At 20 Vitality, shields each ally for 25% of that ally's max HP for two end steps. Value consumed shields across about two exposed allies, reduced for 35 mana, cooldown 6 and expiry. The implementation adds no Armor/Magic Resistance despite the spell description.

bulwark-bash.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. bulwark-bash.rationale: 24.5 mean physical melee damage plus a guaranteed one-turn stun, free with cooldown 2. Reliable denial of a surviving enemy's action and incoming pressure is substantial; do not also add a separate full prevention bonus for the same denied action.

earthshatter.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
earthshatter.rationale: 31.5 mean physical damage per enemy globally, free with cooldown 4. One 50% cast-level roll attempts stuns on all targets; two applied stuns also grant +20 Armor and Magic Resistance for the battle. Price that combined multi-enemy damage/control/sustain package; the defense bonus is absent against a lone enemy.

deflecting-stance.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
deflecting-stance.rationale: At 20 Vitality reflects 55% of incoming damage through the attacker's defenses, subtracting actual reflected damage from the incoming hit. Costs 25 mana and cooldown 4. One target end-step duration makes self-cast expire before the next enemy action; an ally who already acted can benefit. No independent flat 50% reduction is implemented.

bladestorm-rhythm.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
bladestorm-rhythm.rationale: Two immediate physical melee strikes totaling about 76 raw damage for 15 mana and cooldown 4. Large focused burst, reduced for close access, overkill and defense applied separately to each strike; this spell has no charge delay.

iron-will.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
iron-will.rationale: One ally gains +20 Armor and Magic Resistance for two target end steps, for 20 mana and cooldown 6; below 30% HP it also heals 10% max HP. Credit useful incoming mitigation and conditional rescue. Cleansing removes DEBUFF effects only, not DOT, STUN or CURSE; self-cast immediately consumes a duration tick.

arcane-channeling.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
arcane-channeling.rationale: 32 raw magical damage per original surviving enemy at effective INT 20, globally. ChargeEffect(2) consumes the casting turn and one further blocked activation: judge its roughly 64 two-target payoff across two committed actions, then discount delay, caster death, lost targets, 40 mana and cooldown 6. Roughly half the value of an otherwise comparable immediate release; a larger discharge can fit the same Might budget. Uses live INT at release and scales sharply at higher INT.

fleetfoot-gambit.conditions: Spells v1: effective attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters, 1–3 enemies and 1–2 allies, defenses 0 or 12. Reference 100: immediate 20 average single-target damage, range 1–3, 10 mana, configured cooldown 1. Compare useful damage, healing, prevention and denied actions; account for mana, cooldown, positioning, charge actions, delayed payoff and target loss. Local areas assume about 1.5 useful targets, global effects 2; never assume every tile is occupied.
fleetfoot-gambit.rationale: Grants an extra action next round to one ally at range 3, for 50 mana and cooldown 8. Self-cast trades away the present action; the gain is timing and upkeep, not an entirely free attack. Transferring an action to a stronger ally has more value, but recipients, survival and mana constrain the package.

iron-sword.conditions: Weapons v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, no other gear/passives, 3- and 7-round encounters with defenses 0 or 12 and movement on an open board. Iron Sword is the 100 reference: +6 Strength and its physical melee attack profile. Compare the complete equipped package including range, spell scaling and regeneration. Weapon values are not comparable with armor values.
iron-sword.rationale: Weapon family reference. +6 Strength and a range-1 physical profile averaging 14 damage at base Strength 20. Includes the weapon's stat contribution to physical spells; not just the +6 modifier in isolation.

oakwarden-staff.conditions: Weapons v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, no other gear/passives, 3- and 7-round encounters with defenses 0 or 12 and movement on an open board. Iron Sword is the 100 reference: +6 Strength and its physical melee attack profile. Compare the complete equipped package including range, spell scaling and regeneration. Weapon values are not comparable with armor values.
oakwarden-staff.rationale: +8 Intelligence with a range-3 magical attack averaging 14.5 damage at base INT 20, plus spell scaling and 1.6 mana regeneration. Reach improves access relative to the reference sword; magic resistance and non-caster builds reduce the advantage.

iron-cuirass.conditions: Armor v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, sword/staff, no other armor/passives; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed physical/magical threats and opportunities to cast. Iron Cuirass (+12 armor) is the 100 reference. Compare useful mitigation with Intelligence scaling and mana regeneration across the encounter, including damage-type and build dependence.
iron-cuirass.rationale: Armor family reference. +12 flat armor prevents physical damage on repeated hits without an action or mana cost. It offers no magic resistance; value depends on the encounter's damage mix.

int-armor.conditions: Armor v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP/mana, sword/staff, no other armor/passives; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed physical/magical threats and opportunities to cast. Iron Cuirass (+12 armor) is the 100 reference. Compare useful mitigation with Intelligence scaling and mana regeneration across the encounter, including damage-type and build dependence.
int-armor.rationale: +10 Intelligence increases magical scaling and adds 2 mana regeneration, but supplies no armor. Useful on a caster who spends the extra mana; less consistent than the reference cuirass across mixed builds and short encounters.

armor-up.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
armor-up.rationale: 20% more existing armor means +2.4 on the 12-armor reference. Only physical incoming hits benefit and short fights offer fewer such hits. Exactly zero mitigation on a zero-armor build; do not treat it as +20 flat armor.

thorn-carapace.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
thorn-carapace.rationale: Reflects 20% of received damage through the attacker's defenses, with no reduction to the original incoming hit. Values useful retaliation over several attacks; no recursive reflection and no credit for overkill.

blessed-fortune.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
blessed-fortune.rationale: +5 Blessed raises the capped d20 result used for damage/heal interpolation. On a 0–15 weapon roll this adds roughly 3.3 raw damage per attack before defense across a long encounter. It does not increase independent effect-proc or critical-hit chances.

bloodfang.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
bloodfang.rationale: Adds 10% lifesteal to actual physical damage only. Seven reference physical attacks can recover roughly 10 HP before overhealing; multi-target physical abilities improve it. No benefit to a purely magical damage build.

soulleech.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
soulleech.rationale: Adds 5% omnivamp, but the current damage calculator applies it only in the nonphysical branch. Values conditional healing from magical attacks/spells, limited by missing HP and actual damage. It is not 5% healing from all damage types in this implementation.

mystic-flow.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
mystic-flow.rationale: 25% more mana regeneration: at effective INT 20, 4 becomes 5 per turn. About 7 additional mana over seven turns, only useful if spent on a better available action; it does not itself grant attacks or damage.

vital-wellspring.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
vital-wellspring.rationale: 25% more health regeneration: the reference hero's 10 becomes 12.5, rounded to 13 during recovery. About 21 extra HP over seven injured turns, less when healthy or in short fights. Bot regeneration differs and is valued in each enemy kit instead.

stoneform-resolve.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
stoneform-resolve.rationale: Gains +1 Armor and Magic Resistance per completed combat round, capped at 15 and reset each battle. Accumulating prevention against both damage types is strong over seven rounds; do not grant all 15 stacks upfront or count protection after death.

titans-resurgence.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
titans-resurgence.rationale: Once per battle, a living owner at or below 30% HP starts four turns of 7.5%-max-HP healing. At 100 max HP the nominal total is 30, discounted for never crossing the threshold, death before activation/completion, and overhealing. Larger enemy HP pools amplify it.

keen-instincts.conditions: Passives v1: base attributes 20, 100 HP, sword/staff, 12 armor, 0 magic resistance and 0 crit; 3- and 7-round encounters with mixed incoming damage. Reference 100: about 20 additional useful HP of encounter contribution over 7 rounds, without spending an action. Evaluate the change from removing this passive, including wasted healing, eligible damage types, activation conditions and survival. No credit for hypothetical unavailable crit gear.
keen-instincts.rationale: Multiplies existing critical chance by 1.25 and adds 0.5 critical damage. The reference has zero critical chance and current catalogue equipment supplies none, so neither modifier changes outcomes. This is a rated conditional zero, not missing metadata; reassess when positive-crit builds are supported.

goblin.conditions: Enemies v1: Skeleton Grunt is the 100 reference. Compare the full authored kit against two 100-HP/100-mana heroes, base attributes 20 (second agility 19), sword/staff, no armor/passives, Basic Attack only. Real tactical movement and heuristic AI for both sides; empty 7x7 board, clustered/spread starts, 16 matched seeds each, 15-round limit. Weigh pressure, durability, control and sustain together. Unfinished runs are censored, not victories; see enemy-probes.json. Values are estimates, not win-rate ratios.
goblin.rationale: 20 HP, low offensive attributes and Basic Attack. Equipment, Blessed and Armor Up improve the kit but do not overcome low durability: probes averaged 3.25 damage to the party versus the reference's 8.19.
